test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) should follow (B) traffic rules (C) strictly (D) everyone
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **DABC**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Everyone," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Following the subject, "should follow" **(DA)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what everyone should do.
 
• **The next part,** "traffic rules" **(B)**, specifies what is being followed.
 
• **Ending with** "strictly" **(C)** completes the sentence by emphasizing how the rules should be followed.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DABC.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (DCAB):** This option starts with "Everyone strictly should follow traffic rules," which makes the sentence incorrect due to improper placement of the adverb "strictly."
 
• **Option 3 (DBCA):** This option starts with "Everyone traffic rules should follow strictly," which disrupts the logical sequence of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (DACB):** This option starts with "Everyone should follow strictly traffic rules," which is grammatically awkward and unclear.
